comment: Shared config-validation corpus. The wrapper (C, wrapper/src/config.c)
and the daemon (Go, daemon/internal/config) each parse and validate the
same schema-v2 config files. They are separate implementations, so they
can drift apart silently: a config the daemon happily discovers can be
rejected by the wrapper at startup, or vice versa.
This file is the single source of truth for which configs are valid.
both read it and assert their own validator agrees, case by case. Adding
a case here without fixing both validators turns the build red.
docs/config-schema.md is the prose reference; this corpus is its

cases.why: plain http to the loopback name
RFC 3986 bracketed IPv6 loopback with a port; both validators must strip the brackets before comparing the host
bracketed IPv6 loopback with no port
remote hosts are out of scope for v1
the loopback check is whole-host, not a prefix match
https is out of scope for v1
no host between the scheme and the port
stdio backend with an absolute command and args
command and url are mutually exclusive
exactly one of command or url is required
schema v1 is no longer accepted
name is required; the daemon routes reload broadcasts by it
source/upgrade/check_interval were retired in v0.8.0 and must still load, ignored
